resources.string: During calls in Google Phone or Samsung Phone, uses the proximity sensor to switch between the earpiece and speaker. It does not read or store screen content.
Automatically switches call audio in a supported Phone app: at your ear — earpiece, moved away — speaker.
If the service switch is disabled: open App info, select the ⋮ menu and choose “Allow restricted settings”.
Make a normal SIM call. Move the phone away from your ear for about half a second — the speaker should turn on. Move it back to your ear to return to the earpiece.
The app does not record calls, store screen content or use analytics. It connects only to GitHub to check and download updates selected by you.
None — complete setup and make a test call.
If AutoSpeaker is useful to you, you can voluntarily support its continued development.
